```yaml
name: Integration Nightly

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs at midnight UTC every day
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  generate-matrix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      
      - name: Generate matrix
        id: generate
        run: echo "::set-output name=matrix::$(node matrix-generator.ts)"

  run-integration-tests:
    needs: generate-matrix
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix: ${{fromJson(needs.generate_matrix.outputs.matrix)}}
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      
      - name: Run integration test
        run: node run-single.ts --config ${{ matrix.config }}

  run-community-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      
      - name: Run community tests
        run: node community-runner.ts

  summarize-results:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [run-integration-tests, run-community-tests]
    
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: yarn install
      
      - name: Summarize results
        run: |
          echo "Integration Tests Results:"
          cat integration-tests/results.json
          echo "Community Tests Results:"
          cat community-tests/results.json
```
